messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Canary rollout 'canary-api-v2' in eu-west-1 -> 5xx rate 6.2% over 3m. Auto-pause engaged. Pager: @oncall-ana. Incident ID: INC-2026-9821

oncall-ana: joining. thanks. quick question — are we seeing user-facing errors or only internal probes?

support-jordan: seeing ~40% failed requests for a small set of customers routed to canary. Two support tickets opened. Ops doc: https://redwood.internal/ops/INC-2026-9821 (adding list of impacted accounts)

sre-mike: looking at pod metrics — canary backend nodes showing OOM spikes + high GC. Logs: repeated "kv_cache_prefetch_error" and "prefetch queue full". Pod examples: canary-api-v2-5f7d, canary-api-v2-6a2c.

eng-ana: can we confirm whether auto-rollback is enabled? want to know if the rollout engine will revert automatically.

incident-bot: Auto-rollback: DISABLED (policy: manual for staged canaries). Rollout paused at 09:41:12 UTC and traffic shifted down to 10% as mitigation. No rollback executed because health checks ambiguous for tail latencies.

oncall-ana: OK — immediate plan: perform manual feature-flag kill-switch to stop canary traffic, then drain canary pods and validate. @eng-ana please flip the FF and confirm. @sre-mike coordinate drain.

eng-ana: flipping flag now -> `ff.route.canary_api_v2 = false` ... response: 200 OK. :white_check_mark: Beginning 30s ramp to stable 100%.

sre-mike: commencing graceful drain on canary pods. command: ```kubectl cordon canary-api-v2-5f7d && kubectl drain canary-api-v2-5f7d --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data``` draining replicas: 2/2. Expect connections to finish in ~45s.

support-jordan: updated customer impact to "partial degraded" and notified the two affected accounts. No escalation to CSM yet. ticket ids: S-1457, S-1458.

eng-ana: metrics update: error-rate down to 0.5% within 90s of flag flip. p95 latency back to baseline. No new OOMs observed on stable.

oncall-ana: good. let's keep canary disabled until follow-up. Verification checklist before closing: 1) run synthetic smoke (login, create, inference flows) 2) confirm 5xx < 0.1% for 15m 3) p95 latency within 10% of baseline 4) search logs for recent OOM/kv errors 5) create follow-up JIRA for root-cause + remediation.

pm-lee: documented impact and customers in INC ticket. Proposed short-term remediation: increase canary JVM heap + reduce prefetch concurrency. Long-term: cache tuning + better preflight healthchecks.

incident-bot: MITIGATED: manual flag revert + pod drain. Incident marked resolved at 09:44:00 UTC. Incident ID INC-2026-9821. React with :thumbsup: if no further action required or leave a note for the follow-up ticket.

oncall-ana: closing this thread for now. follow-up assignees: @eng-ana (investigation), @sre-mike (postmortem ops). I'll pull a short postmortem doc for next steps.

support-jordan: adding final note — CS will follow up with affected accounts and offer status update.

eng-ana: creating ticket: RW-INVEST-2319 for root cause + remediation plan.

sre-mike: saving logs & heap dumps to /reduced-incidents/INC-2026-9821/ for the oncall rotation to review.

incident-bot: THREAD CLOSED (mitigated -> monitoring)."
